title: The Cross-Border Client File
brief: A simulated Deutsche Bank client service team needs records for an overseas meeting, but the proposed transfer route is not approved.
objective: Enable the client request while protecting confidential information and observing transfer controls.

nodes.speaker: International Client Service Lead
nodes.message: The client meeting starts soon. Upload the full relationship file to my personal cloud drive so the overseas team can open it.
nodes.prompt: How do you deliver the information safely?

artifact.title: Overseas client file request
artifact.body: The package contains identity documents, account history, contact details and relationship notes.

choices.label: Confirm the business need, minimize the file and use the approved secure route.
choices.consequence: Only necessary data is delivered through an authorized and auditable channel.

choices.label: Use the personal drive because access can be revoked after the meeting.
choices.consequence: Sensitive client information leaves the controlled environment.

choices.label: Email the full archive with a password sent in the same thread.
choices.consequence: A password does not make an unapproved transfer route acceptable.
